brief: Goldman Sachs equity sales note, 10 September 2026. US equities fell a second day: SPX -48bps to 7636, NDX -29bps, RTY -132bps, crude above USD100, and 10 and 20 year Treasury yields at 2023 highs. META rose 6.6% on its Muse AI agent announcement. European indices sit below 50 day averages and short term momentum thresholds, which GS models say triggered CTA selling it expects to continue. GS argues the setup is bullish because positioning, not earnings, is depressed: Q2 S&P 500 EPS grew about 30% yoy while sentiment sits in bearish territory, NDX100 shorts are up 35% since June, Q3 de-grossing ran 8pp, and fundamental long/short net leverage is in the 6th percentile. The lowest ever S&P 6m realized correlation is judged unsustainable and historically resolves in index vol convexity. Calls: buy the AI hardware basket GSTMTDAT, since geopolitical, midterm and Fed uncertainty favours secular growth with little economic sensitivity over 12 months. Buy German fiscal, defence, capex and domestic recovery baskets on 17% EPS growth against 9% for the Stoxx. Buy Alpha, Piraeus and Eurobank, neutral NBG. Inditex Buy, PT EUR61. GS expects a fully priced 25bps ECB hike and thinks September is the cycle's last.
